purpose: Independently review all accepted Go cards and actual combined check evidence before local candidate integration.

execution.instructions: Read original request, accepted plan/card manifest, current combined patch and full scoped Go execution proof. Follow AGENTS.md and judge each card acceptance condition, public contracts, necessary source, ownership, regression purpose and proof completeness. Internal card commits are unreviewed. Do not edit, execute checks, Git, agents or external work. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only for complete source/proof; concrete in-scope findings return changes_requested with verdict BLOCKED. Missing/inconclusive capability or a material decision returns blocked. Never waive acceptance or widen permissions. Summary <=240 characters.
